build_cg_change_mat: build a python module that computes the 9x9 Clebsch-Gordan change-of-basis matrix for angular momentum 2
run_cg_change_mat_on_gpu: run cg_change_mat to return the change-of-basis tensor placed on a specified GPU device
test_irreps_sum: test irreps_sum to verify it returns the correct sum of irrep dimensions for a given angular momentum
refactor_cg_change_mat: refactor cg_change_mat to support angular momentum values beyond 2 instead of raising NotImplementedError
summarize_irreps_sum: summarize the irreps_sum function that computes the cumulative dimension count of irreps up to a max angular momentum
